translation_process: Primary source was the digital Mahāsaṅgīti edition of the Pāli Tipiṭaka (with additional checking against the PTS Pāli edition). Translated from the Pāli, with reference to several English translations, especially that of I.B. Horner.
translation_description: This ongoing (and still very much incomplete) translation of the Milindapañha is part of a project to translate and make available online the Pali Nikāyas with the following aims: plain, approachable English; consistent terminology; accurate rendition of the Pali; free of copyright. This project was commenced in 2023.
